term: uncaused cause prior to every caused object
definition: There are N and M such that N has no incoming G-edge, N causes M, M covers all caused simples, and N is Prior to every G-caused object.
note: M is only a COVER, not a full fusion or the object proved universally prior. N-priority does not imply direct causation of every object, uniqueness, priority to uncaused objects, necessary existence or God. Rutten full first-cause effect-priority-or-inclusion is a distinct stronger endpoint.
